system.description: The Sidereal perceives the subtle flaws in the design of objects, plans, or works and mends them with a touch of fate. This Charm allows the character to identify and correct fundamental flaws in a crafted object or engineered design. By spending an hour in meditation with the flawed work, the Sidereal may remove a single fundamental defect—a hidden stress fracture, a flawed formula, a structural error—that would otherwise cause the work to eventually fail. Objects repaired with this Charm gain a measure of fated durability.
